name: FactPICO
description: FactPICO is a factuality benchmark for plain language summarization of medical evidence from randomized controlled trials, containing 345 summaries with expert evaluations of critical PICO elements and additional information correctness, aimed at assessing factual accuracy in medical summarization.
reputation: A niche but credible medical factuality benchmark that is useful for evaluating summarization faithfulness in evidence-based medicine, though it is not yet widely adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Evaluates factuality of PICO elements and extra information; existing metrics correlate poorly with expert judgments.
